ambiguity: You asked for a lookup by name without saying how loosely to match: case, punctuation, or surrounding whitespace.

facts.fact: Treat a hyphen and an underscore as the same character; people type either.
Do not trim the input. Signup rejects names with leading or trailing spaces, so a padded name is somebody who does not exist and must not match.
